title: Differential of explicit subset insertion
statement: For every A,r,f,J as in [def-sc-principal-open-cech-subset-insertion], let D_S=D(product_{j∈S} f_j) and let B be the additive tuple total. Given the restriction inequalities D_S≤D_(S erase j) and the degree transports n+1-|S erase j|=n+2-|S| when j∈S, for every n and raw coordinate function s, d_B(insert_n(s)) equals insert_(n+1) applied to the function whose S coordinate is (-1)^(|S|-1) times the coefficient differential of s_S plus the signed restriction sum over j∈S of s_(S erase j), transported to coefficient degree n+2-|S|. The sign of j is (-1)^|{i∈S:i<j}| and empty deletions contribute zero. The formula is the exact one in the Lean statement below. This assertion involves only the explicit map and tuple total, with no assumed differential formula for another complex.

proof.text: Expand the mapped total differential using Mathlib total_d and additivity of the forgetful functor. Apply the horizontal and vertical component identities. Commute the two summands to the displayed order and use additivity of principalSubsetInsertion to combine the two coordinate functions. No section, face, or degree transport is assumed beyond the original hypotheses.
